source_caption:
🎬 Status Update (2018)

Status Update follows Kyle Moore, a teenager struggling to adjust to a new life after his parents’ separation forces him to move to a different town and start over at an unfamiliar high school. Feeling lonely and desperate to fit in, Kyle unexpectedly discovers a mysterious smartphone app that can turn anything he posts into reality. Suddenly, his wildest dreams begin coming true, transforming him from an unpopular outsider into one of the most admired students at school. With his newfound abilities, Kyle gains popularity, athletic talent, and the attention of the girl he likes. However, as his wishes become increasingly complicated, he begins to realize that having everything he wants doesn’t necessarily bring genuine happiness. Starring Ross Lynch, Olivia Holt, and Courtney Eaton, the film delivers hilarious moments, teenage romance, and a heartwarming story about friendship, honesty, self-confidence, and discovering what truly matters in life.

🎭 Genre: Comedy • Fantasy • Romance • Teen Drama

⭐ IMDb: 5.8/10

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 46m • PG-13

🎥 Director: Scott Speer

✍️ Writer: Jason Filardi

source_details.synopsis: Status Update is a 2018 American teen romantic comedy film directed by Scott Speer and written by Jason Filardi. It stars longtime Disney Channel actors Ross Lynch and Olivia Holt. The film had a limited release on March 23, 2018, before being released through video on demand on March 30, 2018, by Vertical Entertainment.
